  <section class="bbb-case-section" id="why-this-exists" aria-labelledby="bbb-why-title">
    <div class="bbb-section-head"><div><p class="bbb-kicker">The problem</p><h2 id="bbb-why-title">Make the evidence<br><em>easier to inspect.</em></h2></div><p>Separate project pages explain individual builds. A shared inventory makes their controls comparable without turning the portfolio into a ranking.</p></div>
    <div class="bbb-three">
      <article class="bbb-card"><span class="bbb-step">01</span><h3>Find the check</h3><p>Rebuilds, source governance, numerical checks, presentation review and operation sit in a common vocabulary.</p></article>
      <article class="bbb-card"><span class="bbb-step">02</span><h3>Read its actual state</h3><p>A report can exist while a check fails, remains deferred or covers only part of the requirement. Its presence alone cannot establish a pass.</p></article>
      <article class="bbb-card"><span class="bbb-step">03</span><h3>Keep the history</h3><p>The original ten builds retain every recorded cell. Older projects are not retrofitted to fill the table, and an absent historical artifact creates no remediation debt.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="bbb-case-section" aria-labelledby="bbb-marks-title">
    <div class="bbb-section-head"><div><p class="bbb-kicker">Reading the comparison</p><h2 id="bbb-marks-title">Four states.<br><em>A clearer distinction.</em></h2></div><p>Shape and color carry the state together. Select a mark in the matrix for the path, recorded result and available evidence.</p></div>
    <div class="bbb-state-grid">
      <article class="bbb-state"><span class="bbb-state-mark bbb-recorded" aria-hidden="true">●</span><h3>Artifact recorded</h3><p>A qualifying artifact was recorded. Its scope and actual outcome still matter.</p></article>
      <article class="bbb-state"><span class="bbb-state-mark bbb-limited" aria-hidden="true">◐</span><h3>Limited evidence</h3><p>The record retains a failure, deferral, open item or other limit. Completion is not established.</p></article>
      <article class="bbb-state"><span class="bbb-state-mark bbb-absent" aria-hidden="true">−</span><h3>Not carried</h3><p>The original inventory did not record a qualifying artifact for that surface.</p></article>
      <article class="bbb-state"><span class="bbb-state-mark bbb-unknown" aria-hidden="true">?</span><h3>Not assessed</h3><p>The retained evidence cannot establish presence or absence against the additional definition.</p></article>
    </div>
    <p class="bbb-note">This is a categorical inventory. Artifact counts are not quality percentages, maturity scores or business-performance measures.</p>
  </section>

  <section class="bbb-case-section" id="what-changed" aria-labelledby="bbb-change-title">
    <div class="bbb-section-head"><div><p class="bbb-kicker">The Claim Integrity extension</p><h2 id="bbb-change-title">Two more questions<br><em>the inventory can ask.</em></h2></div><p>The original matrix covered ten builds and fourteen surfaces. Claim Integrity adds a build and two definitions, while retaining the earlier evidence.</p></div>
    <div class="bbb-two">
      <article class="bbb-card bbb-capability"><span class="bbb-tag">15 / Operation</span><h3>What should have arrived?</h3><p><strong>Expected event accounting</strong> starts from independently retained triggering facts. A claim never constructed or a promised response never received remains expected work, with its cutoff and timing basis.</p><p class="bbb-card-foot">The obligation itself is explicit, extending population reconciliation beyond the records that arrived.</p><a href="https://www.robbinsanalytics.com/cascadia-build-by-build/#definition-expected_event_accounting" class="no-external">Read the counting rule <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></article>
      <article class="bbb-card bbb-capability bbb-mist"><span class="bbb-tag">16 / Numbers</span><h3>Did the controls detect it?</h3><p><strong>Detection evaluation</strong> retains eligible failures and clean opportunities, including misses, false alarms, timing and cases not yet observable.</p><p class="bbb-card-foot">Claim Integrity carries limited historical evidence here. Independent evaluator custody was not established.</p><a href="https://www.robbinsanalytics.com/cascadia-build-by-build/#definition-detection_evaluation" class="no-external">Read the counting rule <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></article>
    </div>
    <p class="bbb-note">The twenty new cells for earlier builds are <strong>not assessed</strong>. The original fourteen-column inventory cannot settle either new capability, and no first-ever capability claim is made. These are additions to this portfolio inventory, not a change to the shared standards repository.</p>
  </section>

  <section class="bbb-case-section" id="how-it-works" aria-labelledby="bbb-how-title">
    <div class="bbb-section-head"><div><p class="bbb-kicker">The implementation</p><h2 id="bbb-how-title">One retained baseline.<br><em>A traceable extension.</em></h2></div><p>Python combines local JSON records into a static HTML, CSS and JavaScript page. The same inventory feeds the homepage count and miniature.</p></div>
    <ol class="bbb-flow" aria-label="From source evidence to the page">
      <li><span class="bbb-kicker">01 / Retain</span><h3>Original freeze</h3><p>The ten-build inventory and its design-standard history keep their October 7 freeze.</p></li>
      <li><span class="bbb-kicker">02 / Extend</span><h3>Pinned evidence</h3><p>Claim Integrity's row adds source identities, recorded outcomes and their scope.</p></li>
      <li><span class="bbb-kicker">03 / Separate</span><h3>Artifact and result</h3><p>A dedicated evidence register keeps a path distinct from the conclusion it can support.</p></li>
      <li><span class="bbb-kicker">04 / Render</span><h3>Page and miniature</h3><p>A deterministic builder renders the comparison; the website consumes the same extended inventory.</p></li>
    </ol>
    <div class="bbb-three bbb-stack">
      <article class="bbb-card"><h3>A table that can be read</h3><p>Real row and column headers preserve context. Build and group filters narrow the comparison; sticky headers and build names stay visible while scrolling.</p></article>
      <article class="bbb-card"><h3>Evidence within reach</h3><p>Keyboard-operable cells open the evidence panel with the path, recorded outcome, scope and available artifact or verification summary.</p></article>
      <article class="bbb-card"><h3>A small static stack</h3><p>Local JSON and a static page fit a categorical comparison. No chart library or database is needed for this inventory.</p></article>
    </div>
    <details class="bbb-fold" id="architecture-detail"><summary>Architecture and provenance</summary><div>
      <dl class="bbb-provenance"><div><dt>Original baseline</dt><dd><code>data/builds.json</code> and <code>data/standard.json</code> retain their October 7 freeze at <code>66b9de6</code>. No reread or retrofit of those ten repositories is implied.</dd></div><div><dt>Claim Integrity extension</dt><dd>Repository evidence is pinned to <code>e936d1a</code>. Recorded outcomes come from the frozen public verification snapshot. Served snapshot bytes and later repository artifact bytes retain separate identities where they differ.</dd></div><div><dt>Deterministic inventory</dt><dd><code>src/extend_inventory.py</code> combines the baseline and authored extension. Check mode verifies the unchanged baseline, extension hashes, row and column shape, and explicit not-assessed states.</dd></div><div><dt>Publication builder</dt><dd><code>src/build_expanded_page.py</code> renders the matrix, definitions, scope notes and historical design-standard lane. Website counts and its miniature use the same expanded inventory.</dd></div></dl>
      <p>The extension is additive. It does not claim all eleven repositories were audited on one date.</p><a href="https://www.robbinsanalytics.com/cascadia-build-by-build/#definitions" class="no-external">Inspect the definitions and provenance <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
    </div></details>
  </section>

  <section class="bbb-case-section" id="testing-and-limits" aria-labelledby="bbb-testing-title">
    <div class="bbb-section-head"><div><p class="bbb-kicker">Testing and scope</p><h2 id="bbb-testing-title">State what was checked.<br><em>Keep the limits visible.</em></h2></div><p>Focused integration checks support this interface update. They do not replace the underlying builds' assurance records or certify the effectiveness of their controls.</p></div>
    <div class="bbb-two">
      <article class="bbb-card bbb-checked"><span class="bbb-tag">This integration</span><h3>What was checked</h3><ul><li>Preservation of all 140 original matrix cells.</li><li>Twenty explicit not-assessed cells in the new legacy columns.</li><li>Deterministic output, recorded outcomes and internal destinations.</li><li>Responsive rendering, navigation, filters and keyboard interaction.</li></ul><p>Check receipts accompany the candidate. The original inventory's validation and panel records remain historical evidence.</p></article>
      <article class="bbb-card"><span class="bbb-tag">Interpretation</span><h3>What the checks establish</h3><p>The retained inventory can be reproduced, its evidence can be followed and its current interface can be reviewed.</p><p>An earlier panel did not review this redesigned layout. No new blind panel or assurance cycle is claimed for this UI update.</p><p>A recorded artifact can carry failed, blocked, deferred, open or historical results. Those states remain visible.</p></article>
    </div>
    <aside class="bbb-scope" aria-labelledby="bbb-scope-title"><div><p class="bbb-kicker">Claim Integrity / Accepted scope</p><h3 id="bbb-scope-title">Historical results retain their limits.</h3></div><div><p>Unblinded attempt 2 met must-catch in <strong>20 of 26 represented classes</strong>, with 36 registered, six missed targets and ten unrepresented classes. Independent evaluator custody was not established; no effectiveness claim is made for the final controls.</p><p>The build is owner-accepted for a personal website as a frozen synthetic snapshot. Current chart re-review is deferred, and four minor clarity items remain open in a restricted simulated panel. A successful scheduled-run receipt is not required at that scope.</p><p>Its second derivation matched all <strong>22,173 published cells</strong> while the recorded surface status remains <strong>fail</strong>. Numerical agreement does not relabel that result.</p><a href="https://www.robbinsanalytics.com/cascadia-claim-integrity/case-study.html" class="no-external">Read the Claim Integrity case study <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></aside>
  </section>

  <section class="bbb-case-section" id="build-forward" aria-labelledby="bbb-forward-title">
    <div class="bbb-section-head"><div><p class="bbb-kicker">Build forward</p><h2 id="bbb-forward-title">What a next iteration<br><em>could establish.</em></h2></div><p>These are future investigations, not work represented as completed in this inventory.</p></div>
    <div class="bbb-two"><article class="bbb-card"><span class="bbb-step">01 / Earlier builds</span><h3>Which older artifacts meet the new definitions?</h3><p>Inspect the earlier candidate artifacts under an explicit scope. Presence or absence needs evidence; it cannot be inferred from the old fourteen columns.</p></article><article class="bbb-card bbb-mist"><span class="bbb-step">02 / Detector evaluation</span><h3>What would independent custody establish?</h3><p>A future independently controlled evaluation could test detection and evaluator validity under conditions the current historical record cannot establish.</p></article></div>
  </section>
